screen_name: Onboarding > Tracking Preference (choose expense tracking mode)

text.usage: subtitle 'You can change this later in settings.' and card body descriptions

accent.usage: selected card border, check badge, selected icon circle fill, back arrow, logo

weights_observed.role: page heading, subtitle, card titles, body text

typography.line_height_notes: normal; card body descriptions wrap with comfortable (~1.4) leading

corner_radius_observed.usage: icon circles and selection check badge

shadows_observed.description: very subtle, diffuse drop shadow under cards (more visible on selected card)

components.state_visible: active/selected ('Expense Only' with blue filled icon circle and blue circular check badge top-right)
default ('Expense + Budgeting' with light gray-blue circular icon background, no check badge)

content_patterns: Question-form heading ('How do you want to track your expenses?') with reassuring subtitle ('You can change this later in settings.'). Two mutually-exclusive choice cards each with title + one-to-two-sentence plain-language description. Friendly, jargon-free tone ('Just log what you spend', 'manage your financial health'). Selection conveyed via check badge rather than a separate confirm button visible on screen.
notable_interactions: Cards are tappable single-select options: selected state shows blue border, filled blue icon circle, and circular check badge top-right; unselected card shows gray border without badge. Subtitle implies the choice is reversible via Settings. Back arrow implies navigation to previous onboarding step. No visible Continue/Next button in this frame.
